answer: Try whistleblower bounties. Every new identity locks 20 POA. Anyone who signs one message with two private keys proves both belong to one operator. The ledger then slashes every stake linked to those keys and pays half to the signer. So a farm of 500 fakes becomes a beacon for its own betrayal: one leaked key or one bored contractor collects 5,000 POA, about $2,500, while the farmer loses 10,000 POA and months of setup. Every helper he hires is a paid informant in waiting. Running sybils here is like hiding a pearl in a shallow lagoon full of divers paid to find it.
